pr_body:
This pull request implements shift+double/triple click. Proper behavior
(as described in #4557) is to only expand one selection point, not both.

Adding the `bool targetStart` was a bit weird. I decided on this being
the cleanest approach though because I still want `PivotSelection` to be
its own helper function. Otherwise, the concept of "pivoting" gets kinda
messy.

## Validation Steps Performed
Manual testing as described on attached issue.
Tests were added for Shift+Click and pivoting the selection too.

Closes #4557

review_comments:
I'd like to see a test that does a simulates a shift double-click, drag, _drag back_.

I'd expect it to go from doubleClickMe to dragThroughHere, and then totally deselect dragThroughHere when you drag back.
Good callout. It revealed a regression in the TermControl so I moved the touchdown pos back. 😊

Shift+Click, then drag was broken.
Before latest commit: drag --> clear and start a new selection
now: drag --> only set the "end" of selection

I think I used to only test Shift+Click, then Shift+Click somewhere else.
